Annotation Interface EnableLoadTimeWeaving

@Target(TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @Import(LoadTimeWeavingConfiguration.class) public @interface EnableLoadTimeWeaving
Activates a Spring LoadTimeWeaver for this application context, available as a bean with the name "loadTimeWeaver", similar to the <context:load-time-weaver> element in Spring XML.

用于在 `@Configuration` 类上；最简单的示例如下：

@Configuration
@EnableLoadTimeWeaving
public class AppConfig {

    // application-specific @Bean definitions ...
}
The example above is equivalent to the following Spring XML configuration: 
<beans>

    <context:load-time-weaver/>

    <!-- application-specific <bean> definitions -->

</beans>

The LoadTimeWeaverAware interface

Any bean that implements the LoadTimeWeaverAware interface will then receive the LoadTimeWeaver reference automatically; for example, Spring's JPA bootstrap support.

自定义LoadTimeWeaver

The default weaver is determined automatically: see DefaultContextLoadTimeWeaver.

要自定义使用的织入器，可以添加 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving` 注解的 `@Configuration` 类实现 LoadTimeWeavingConfigurer 接口，并通过 #getLoadTimeWeaver 方法返回自定义的 LoadTimeWeaver 实例：

@Configuration
@EnableLoadTimeWeaving
public class AppConfig implements LoadTimeWeavingConfigurer {

    @Override
    public LoadTimeWeaver getLoadTimeWeaver() {
        MyLoadTimeWeaver ltw = new MyLoadTimeWeaver();
        ltw.addClassTransformer(myClassFileTransformer);
        // ...
        return ltw;
    }
}

上面的示例可以与以下 Spring XML 配置进行比较：

<beans>

    <context:load-time-weaver weaverClass="com.acme.MyLoadTimeWeaver"/>

</beans>

该代码示例与 XML 示例不同之处在于，它实际上实例化了MyLoadTimeWeaver类型，这意味着还可以配置该实例，例如调用#addClassTransformer方法。这展示了基于代码的配置方法如何通过直接的程序访问而更加灵活。

启用基于 AspectJ 的织入

AspectJ load-time weaving may be enabled with the aspectjWeaving() attribute, which will cause the AspectJ class transformer to be registered through LoadTimeWeaver.addTransformer(ClassFileTransformer). AspectJ weaving will be activated by default if a "META-INF/aop.xml" resource is present on the classpath. Example: 
@Configuration
@EnableLoadTimeWeaving(aspectjWeaving=ENABLED)
public class AppConfig {
}

上面的示例可以与以下 Spring XML 配置进行比较：

<beans>

    <context:load-time-weaver aspectj-weaving="on"/>

</beans>

这两个示例在功能上是等效的，但有一个显著例外：在 XML 配置中，当 `aspectj-weaving` 设置为 "on" 时，`<context:spring-configured>` 的功能会隐式启用。而在使用 `@EnableLoadTimeWeaving(aspectjWeaving=ENABLED)` 时则不会发生这种情况。相反，您必须显式添加 `@EnableSpringConfigured`（包含在 `spring-aspects` 模块中）。
